title: spatial_auditing
text:
These tabs describe a method for assessing an area at LSOA level for:

areas where children can potentially play
number of KSI collisions
Index of Multiple Deprivation

Tab “Spatial Method” describes the methodology for the Ward of Ardwick
This method is applied to the Local Authority of Manchester, with the scores shown in the table “Manchester scores table” and plotted “Manchester scores map” and “Manchester population map” with the population of Under 18s dissagregated by age band and sex.
